title: Casa Sol
subtitle: Serene living in the heart of the Golf Course
description:
Set quietly against the sweeping greens of Puerto Aventuras, this golf-front residence offers a living experience grounded in space, natural light, and quiet elegance. Here, the boundaries between the interiors and the landscape dissolve, creating a private retreat within the Riviera Maya's premier marina community.

Thoughtfully structured to balance open, inviting spaces with absolute privacy, the home features five serene bedrooms, three offering expansive walk-in closets, and four and a half refined bathrooms. The layout prioritizes organic flow, ensuring every room feels like a natural extension of its tropical surroundings. 

Because the property lines blend directly into the golf course, the private grounds expand seamlessly from 5,167 to 5,812 square feet of usable land. The outdoors serves as the true heart of the home, featuring a private pool and a custom-built grill area, an environment crafted for warm, intimate gatherings under the Caribbean sky. 
            
True luxury is the absence of friction. The estate operates with near-complete autonomy, quietly powered by a comprehensive 30-panel solar system. Arrivals are always seamless, with a dedicated two-car garage and extended parking for three additional vehicles.
highlights: Expanded usable land to 5,812 sq ft
